recentItems.title: Frankie Muniz Details Hitting “Rock Bottom” Weeks After Divorce News | E! News
recentItems.description:
Frankie Muniz isn’t racing away from his struggles. The Malcolm in the Middle actor got candid about what he’s been going through over the last six weeks, admitting his life has felt like “a nightmare I’m praying to wake up from.” “Everything felt heavy, unclear, and like it was falling apart at the same time,” Muniz posted on X Sept. 18. “I wouldn’t wish this season on anyone.” The admission comes over two months after he and wife Paige Price—with whom he shares 5-year-old son Mauz Mosley Muniz—announced their divorce after six years of marriage. recentItems.title: RHOSLC's Angie Katsanevas "Never" Saw Shawn Trujillo Breakup Coming | E! News
recentItems.description:
Angie Katsanevas is getting honest about her breakup from her husband of 27 years, Shawn Trujillo. In an exclusive interview with E! News, The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City star said her split from Trujillo took her by complete surprise, as she wouldn't have expected it “in a million years.” Katsanevas also shared how her friend and castmate Mary Cosby helped their show process the loss of Cosby’s son, Robert Cosby Jr., saying, “In a way, she was carrying us… her strength was part of what helped us get through this.” Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1436251/rhoslcs-angie-katsanevas-says-why-shawn-trujillo-breakup-surprised-her

recentItems.title: Joe Alwyn, Mary Beth Barone Step Out Together in New York City | E! News
recentItems.description:
Joe Alwyn—who dated Taylor Swift for six years before their 2023 breakup—stepped out with Mary Beth Barone after the Overcompensating actress joked about having a “PR relationship” with Lucas Bravo.For the outing, Alwyn, 35, sported a black T-shirt, baggy blue jean, dark sneakers and a baseball hat. Meanwhile, Barone, also 35, wore short black mini dress and metallic blue cowboy boots, which she paired with a pink handbag, gold chain necklaces and a jean jacket in her hand. At one point in the evening, the two hit up a local bar, where Barone donned Alwyn's cap as they chatted at the counter. The sighting comes three months after Alwyn sparked dating rumors with Sarah Pidgeon. In June, he was spotted packing on PDA with the Love Story star during a night out in Brooklyn. recentItems.title: Sha’Carri Richardson Shares How Being a Role Model Keeps Her Going | E! News
recentItems.description:
Sha’Carri Richardson knows how to keep pushing forward. The Olympic champion explained how being a role model motivates her: “You have to keep going—up, down, good, bad, or indifferent," Richardson told USA Sports at the premiere event for Athlos, the new track and field league, on Sept. 18, where she was joined by Gabby Douglas, and Tara Davis-Woodhall. The sprinter also encouraged the next generation to embrace who they are: “Be yourself, have fun, and work hard. I think as long as you do those things, the sky is the floor—honestly, not even the limit.” Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1436223/shacarri-richardson-wears-custom-nike-look-at-athlos-event

recentItems.title: Whitney Leavitt, Kristin Chenoweth, Craig Conover & More Join Traitors | E! News
recentItems.description:
Peacock's The Traitors announced its star-studded cast for season six, including reality stars Whitney Leavitt, Craig Conover and Joey Graziadei. Other big names in the cast include Love Island USA’s JaNa Craig, Olympic snowboarder Chloe Kim, and singers Cody Simpson and Kristin Chenoweth. Alan Cumming is set to host the news season which premieres in 2027. This comes after last years winner Rob Rausch took home the prize money, duping his fellow contestants including fellow Love Island star Maura Higgins.
